text:
Main aapki baat samajh gaya hoon. Aapko cancellation aur refund ka confirmation SMS aur email par jald se jald mil jayega. 

Refund successfully initiate ho chuka hai (₹1,499) aur 3-5 working days mein aapke account mein aa jayega. Aaj humse baat karne ke liye shukriya, aur jo pareshani aapko hui uske liye humein khed hai. Aapka din shubh ho!
